dedupe_keys.name: nakupy ochrannych a zdravotnickych prostredku od 1 1 2020 do 31 8 2020 doprava zbozi

description: Nákupy ochranných a zdravotnických prostředků od 1.1.2020 do 31.8.2020 - doprava zboží is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad. Data obtained within the SAO audit action No. 20/32. The data set contains information about connections and transported goods (summary information for individual connections - air and train transport). Expiry date 30.9.2020. Coverage: Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad. The portal shows the English title as "Purchases of protective and medical devices from 1.1.2020 to 31.8.2020 - transport of goods" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad. Its keywords include doprava, protective equipment, covid-19, kontrola NKÚ, zdravotnické prostředky, ochranné prostředky. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/49370227/945151918/distribuce/2488bbd4235bda3bde4b5fafad0744d7/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
